snippet.title: Voidnomaly trailer ‐ EN
snippet.description:
Watch the trailer of Voidnomaly, the new horror game (Depending on how "horrorific" you want to make it) for PC (Steam) that will launch on december. Inspired by anomaly horror games, find which are the real anomalies, and which are just trying to trick you.

Developed by the indie studio Sabacon Games (plural pending of having more than one game)
